cases.behavior: Recover a returned but rejected archive.execute through the public Archive command without replaying applied Specs or accepting candidate drift.
cases.reproduction: In an isolated Git SDK project, execute the real Spec application and reject its returned outcome to preserve the reported running Action and specs-applied transaction. The 0.5.1 npm Runtime and pre-fix HEAD return exit 73 with no single recoverable Action for archive --recover.
cases.expected: Reconcile the original Action, attempt, input and claim against the original transaction, preserve rejection history, and finish Archive after matching candidate inputs are restored.
cases.forbidden: Recovering with missing or mismatched rejection evidence, accepting changed implementation inputs, creating a replacement apply Action, or rewriting an already applied Spec.
cases.rootCause: The recovery command only converted returned archive.prepare rejections to unknown, while apply and finalize rejections remained running and were excluded from recovery.

cases.behavior: When the archive moves a Git-tracked migration fence out of a transient directory (.comet-state.lock or .comet-state-transaction.json), delivery approves both the deletion of the active path and the write of the archived path; a commit that only deletes the active path without committing the archived copy must be rejected.
cases.reproduction: On the base commit, make the archive commit record both the deletion of the active path and the addition of the archived path. complete-delivery rejects the archive commit, reporting openspec/changes/<change>/.comet-state.lock/.comet-runtime-migration.json as an unapproved path; the .comet-state-transaction.json fence fails identically.
cases.expected: complete-delivery accepts the archive commit and the Run reaches done when the archived copy matches the recorded digest, and rejects the commit when the copy is missing or its content differs.
cases.forbidden: Judging a moved migration fence as an unapproved path, skipping approval for the deletion of the active path, approving the deletion without requiring the archived copy to land in the commit, or accepting an archived copy whose content differs from the recorded digest.
cases.rootCause: tree() excludes both transient directories, so the migration fence is captured only by migrationFiles() into optionalFiles and is remapped to the archive path; delivery approves the deletion side only for paths listed in sources, so the active path had no registration at all.
